title: 膝盖帮忙稳住
description: 成人以前臂和屈膝做低强度侧支撑，上手扶髋。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult holds a gentle kneeling side support on a thick mat, elbow directly beneath the lower shoulder and both knees bent on the floor. The hips lift only enough to create a comfortable straight line from head through hip to the supporting knee. The upper hand rests on the pelvis and the gaze remains forward. Frame the whole body against a simple warm wall with a small clear patch of floor around the mat. Use screenprint-inspired illustration with three bold color separations, crisp silhouettes, minimal texture, and ultramarine, gold, and warm white.
